Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1 which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The flow control 
valves and and pressure control valves types and function as follows:
Valve | Type | Function
Flow Control Valve | 667 
 (70) ET | (one valve per unit) is to minimize flow valve low capacity used during 
 start up the unit
Flow Control Valve | 495 (10) ELT 16A | to 
 control and supply the demand of fuel gas to burner as per load
Flow Control Valve | 475-7(60) EWT | to 
 minimize flow valve low capacity at start up ofunit
Pressure Control Valve | 667-4 (70) EWT | It is a reducing station for fuel gas which receiving from gas company by 
 pressure = 7 bar to 4 bar working parallel during normal operation
Pressure Control Valve | 667(70) ET | to 
 control and regulate the fuel gas flow and working parallel with 
 PCV-16A.
 with flow control valve type 
 495 (10) 
 ELT 16A
